card.fact_statement: The Rebuilding Korea Party endorsed Lee Jae Myung in the 2025 South Korean presidential election.
card.source_span: Rebuilding Korea Party endorsed Lee Jae Myung of Democratic Party for the presidency.

target_qa_variants.question: 2025年の韓国大統領選挙で、祖国革新党はどの候補者を支持しましたか？
target_qa_variants.source_span: Rebuilding Korea Party endorsed Lee Jae Myung of Democratic Party for the presidency.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Rebuilding Korea Party is translated to its official Japanese name 祖国革新党 (조국혁신당). Lee Jae Myung is translated to his kanji name 李在明, with the katakana reading as an alias.

backtranslation_en.question: Which candidate did the Fatherland Innovation Party support in the 2025 South Korean presidential election?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The Japanese translation accurately preserves the fact, using the correct established Japanese names for the Rebuilding Korea Party (祖国革新党) and Lee Jae-myung (李在明).
